name: Resource Pulse
description:
Your computer's vital signs, one glance away.

Resource Pulse shows eight metrics live in the top bar and in a dropdown dashboard, each in its own colour:
• CPU: load per core, frequency, the busiest processes
• Memory: in use, cached, swap, the largest apps
• Battery: charge, time left, health, every battery
• Disk: space on each drive, read and write speed
• Network: speed per interface, today and this month
• Temperature: every sensor and fan, an alert when it runs hot
• Power: what the machine draws
• GPU: load, memory and clock of every GPU

Beyond the numbers:
• Usage tracking: which apps used the processor, memory, disk, graphics and battery, hour by hour, for 14 days
• Diagnostics: what runs in the background, holds memory or drains the battery, with the evidence
• Fix with an agent: hand the findings to a coding agent of your choice; it asks before it changes anything
• Named for screen readers and ready for translation

Light on the system: under 1 % of one core with the panel closed. Everything is measured and kept on this computer.

The preferences window copies text to the clipboard only when asked: the Diagnostics report (Copy report), the agent prompt (Copy prompt) and the commands that make CPU power readable (Copy commands).
